common_verbatim_assumptions: 105C remains modeled copper temperature, not ambient, ferrite body temperature, or permitted X5R body temperature.
42-vertex load-polytope coverage does not by itself prove global voltage extrema for nonlinear constant-power converter equations.
All CORE-powered logic/bias/quiescent demand is included once in the aggregate electronics allowance.
At5V raw, U6 can operate in mild boost; the2A output row VOUT/VIN<=1 is not unconditionally applicable.
B=C=1 A is the selected representative peripheral loading; expand to A/B/C combinations if allocation or return rankings change.
Converter eta_total is an engineering assumption including converter operating loss; additive IQ=0 avoids double counting and does not mean zero physical IQ.
Corrected physical supply entries: TPS2553 pin6 is IN, pin4 is EN; DPS368 pin2 CSB and pin5 SDO are not power entry/return pins.
External ABC load is exactly1A on each of the two named ports;2A aggregate, never2A through one GH contact.
Feed/contact resistance values are illustrative sensitivity inputs, not measured factory bounds. No 50/50 positive or return sharing is imposed.
Filtered branches each have a conditional 20mA budget, with combined IMU VDD+VDDIO <=20mA. Their demand is included once within the electronics aggregate.
Finite native sheet/barrel paths and actual load returns are required; no nominal-width shortcut.
J8 auxiliary feed requires unused SBUS, an empty signal cavity and verified polarity/fit.
Mux selection is prescribed; no startup, hysteresis, switching or backfeed result is implied.
New adversarial electronics-current allocation, not a recovered historical load split.
No duration is assigned. The BEC 30 A peak number does not establish an allowable PCB, contact, harness or servo pulse envelope.
One 7.4 V external BEC drives the actual J6/J8 positive and return pads through four independent finite resistances when both feeds are present.
Servo currents are approximate plotted 7.4 V endpoints held constant for the DC comparison. Voltage dependence, startup, reversal and stall are unknown.
The 15.8/15.9 A servo-only endpoint examples already exceed 10 A continuous BEC capability. The 8.9 A cases need newly solved electronics demand before comparison.
The source voltage is an illustrative ideal external BEC terminal condition; actual regulation, source impedance and current limiting remain unbound.
Two declared spatial illustrations, not weakest-location selections. Actual servo return currents can change rankings; expand to other vertices when needed.

U10 IQ remains the inherited conditional140uA table screen at actual IN6/GND5. Auxiliary2mA sensitivity slices are disabled; any future legacy added_auxiliary_U10.4 label must still map its actual endpoint to IN6 and be renamed before publication.

U11 supply/enable consumption and CORE-powered bias are counted once in the aggregate electronics allowance; their individual injection/contact-current distribution is not separately resolved by this allocation model.
U8 RON row is specified at VINx>=5V, |IOUT|=200mA. Effective RON outside those tests is a sensitivity assumption.
U9 setpoint uses the conservative initial PFM low factor; line/load/ripple and input headroom remain separate guards.
interpretation: Ten of eleven illustration cases pass their board-pad static voltage probes on both grids; the eleventh fails the four6 V servo minima. That raw overallfalse is preserved.

Passing board-pad voltage probes does not establish BEC continuous-current capability. Six cases exceed the preserved10 A continuous BEC reference after solving electronics demand, including all three8.9 A servo-subtotal cases.

Four lead/contact resistors are independent positive and return paths. Sharing is solved, not constrained50/50; crossed resistance can place most positive current through one header and most return current through the other.

Servo load points are approximate plotted7.4 V endpoints held constant as an engineering comparison; they are not manufacturer continuous servo-current ratings. Moderate1/1/1/0.5 A is an illustrative load assignment.
No duration is assigned. A30 A BEC peak figure cannot establish an allowed PCB/contact/harness/servo pulse envelope.

Raw VX servo power bypasses U5. The electronics branch eFuse does not impose a servo-bus current or overvoltage limit. Confirm exact installed servo voltage and feed/header ratings before any installed-system suitability claim.
